description: This file defines an immutable class `ImmutableLiveCommandAnswer` that implements the `LiveCommandAnswer` interface. It encapsulates optional references to a `CommandResponse` and an `Event`, providing factory methods and overrides for `equals`, `hashCode`, and `toString`. The class is part of the package `org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.live.base` and is likely used to represent responses in a live command handling context within the Eclipse Ditto project.
